scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Sunday’s out-of-town evening call compatible with the saved cold-meal routine before the bus leaves Minneapolis.
Emerging Need: The call is finalized without a meal break, then the only flat freezer pack for the insulated lunch sleeve is reported discarded, leaving a required packing component absent.
Decision Context: Saved nutrition guidance defines when a replacement gel pack matters and what ordinary hold terms are acceptable; payment feasibility and store notices determine the short viable window.
Consequence: Once the reservation counter closes, the chilled meal prerequisite cannot be secured before departure, even though packing and the rehearsal have not yet begun.

parameter.title: Duluth civic center strings-and-light run-through
parameter.description: Preliminary out-of-town call; meal break and baggage access still pending. Minneapolis bus load is expected the previous afternoon.

parameter.subject: Sunday Duluth call finalized — no meal break
parameter.body: The Dec 20 run-through is confirmed 14:00-20:30 at Duluth Civic Center. Bus load at the Minneapolis warehouse is Sat Dec 19 at 14:45, with no supply stops after boarding. The call has water refill only and no meal break; musicians should bring any personal food they need for the evening.

parameter.content: I need to confess I borrowed the flat freezer gel pack from your insulated lunch sleeve today. It split in my tote, so I tossed it; your sleeve is back on the shelf but empty.

parameter.description: Tour meal per diem posted for the Dec 20 out-of-town call.

parameter.subject: Pickup window today for slim freezer packs
parameter.body: Slim flat freezer packs are in stock at Midtown Market. Reply by 12:00 today to reserve one at the pickup counter; price is $11.99 at pickup, no fee to hold, and reserved items must be collected before 14:15. Next restock after today is Monday.

parameter.subject: Freezer pack reservations closed
parameter.body: The noon reservation window has closed and the pickup counter is sold out of slim freezer packs. We cannot hold additional units before the 14:15 counter close; next restock remains Monday.
